visualCharacteristics: Featured banner card: wide 2:1 parallax image (2:3 on mobile) with an overlaid body holding optional logo, category, linked title and abstract.
contentPattern: Cells classified by content: pictures (desktop, optional mobile crop, logo last with logo variant) | category paragraph | heading with card link | abstract paragraph(s) | optional link-only CTA paragraph.
usage: Use to feature a single story, case study or product as a large linked banner card.
reuseGuidance: Reuse wherever one highlighted item needs a full-width banner, adding logo when a partner logo is supplied.
